name: HIPAA Overlay
description:
Regime overlay for HIPAA. Carries no membership of its own — it contributes overrides on top of whatever the selected theme policies resolve, so adding it to a configuration changes how existing detections are treated rather than which rules run.

What it enforces: the Safe-Harbor de-identification list (45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)) treats a Social Security number and a date of birth as direct identifiers of an individual, so both are elevated to critical wherever they appear — not only inside health records.

Pair with: the pii and healthcare themes (an empty overlay on its own protects nothing).

Scope: HIPAA — overrides only

overrides.reason: HIPAA Safe-Harbor identifier — SSN identifies the individual directly
HIPAA Safe-Harbor identifier — dates of birth must be removed or generalized to year
